en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy harbor scene with sailing ships and warehouses along the waterfront. A multi‑arched metal city bridge spans a canal or river, carrying a tram and pedestrians. People, carts, and barrels are visible in the foreground on a cobbled quay. At the top of the image, German text reads "Libau" on the left and "Stadt-Brücke" on the right.
